description: Compares deepseek-v4-flash and gpt-5.4-mini on a real-thread fixture (836: Best 34'' 240 Hz OLED ultrawide). 20 PLAN comments lifted verbatim from production extraction output, organized into 6 conversation-threaded subtrees with CONTEXT ancestors — mirroring the shape the production validation pipeline emits per call. 10 PLAN comments carry seeded mistakes across all LLM-emittable validation issue types; 10 are correctly labeled. Baseline `current` prompt is the v4 catalogue-style prompt promoted to production — see `buildValidationSystemPrompt` in libs/thread-processor with the monitor-specific worked-cases catalogue in libs/config/src/lib/categories/monitors/config.json under `promptConfig.validationCases`. Measures per-subtree recall, precision, and suggestion quality.

expectations.desiredOutcome: Across all 6 subtrees combined, the 10 seeded mistakes are flagged with the correct refLabel and issue type. The 10 correctly-labeled refs (m7lgml3, m9kkdnc, nqhx3zt, m7hxs8k, mfsh0st, mqwbt45, m96ejm7, m7i0s8b, m7kq62y, m7j0jia) plus the non-seeded refs on multi-ref seeded comments receive zero issues — silent approval. wrong_* issues include suggestedValue using exact schema enum vocabulary. See `seedManifest` for the programmatic per-comment expectations.

judge.instructions: You are scoring two validation-LLM candidates that critique already-labeled product references. Each candidate's output for this subtree is `{ refs: [{ refLabel, issues: [...] }] }`. Refs are labeled A, B, C... in DFS order WITHIN this subtree (labels reset per call). Score each candidate 1-10 on three dimensions: (1) recall — every seeded mistake whose comment is in this subtree is flagged with the correct refLabel AND correct issue type; (2) precision — silence on correctly-labeled refs (any issue against a correct ref is a precision miss); (3) suggestion quality — wrong_* issues include suggestedValue using exact schema enum vocabulary (sentiment: positive|neutral|negative|mixed; experience: owner|prior_owner|tested|prospective_buyer|reference; depth: comprehensive|detailed|mentioned|superficial; intents: recommendation|issue_report|comparison|experience_report|warning|seeking_advice|question|reputation_report). SEED MANIFEST (only seeds whose comment appears in this subtree count toward recall): m7iviub→wrong_sentiment; mqwb0u3→wrong_experience; m7k0kcb→boundary_violation; m7ixwe2→wrong_intent; m8cne3u q1→low_value_quote; m9k0kf0→wrong_quote_attribution; m7zgon8→speculative_flag_mismatch; m7k21y8→wrong_product; m7qc7m6→wrong_depth; mzgpfcj→wrong_intent. CORRECT REFS (silent approval expected when present): m7lgml3, m9kkdnc, nqhx3zt, m7hxs8k, mfsh0st, mqwbt45, m96ejm7, m7i0s8b, m7kq62y, m7j0jia. If this subtree contains zero seeded mistakes, score recall=10 by default. Hard penalties: missing a seeded mistake that IS present in this subtree → recall ≤5; flagging a correctly-labeled ref → precision ≤5; off-vocabulary suggestedValue → suggestion quality ≤4. Return JSON: { candidates: [{ candidateId, scores: { recall, precision, suggestionQuality }, rationale }], verdict }.
